tomcat: Tomcat Agent CLI — a lightweight AI agent runtime
tomcat.long:
Tomcat is a lightweight AI agent runtime built with Rust.
Supports chat, planning, session management and model switching.
Provides tool extensions, permissions, auditing and browser-assisted UI checks.
tomcat serve runs a shared service; ACP clients connect. See tomcat acp --help.

tomcat.self-install: Install or update this executable; optionally configure user PATH without changing model configuration or running services
tomcat.self-install.add_to_path: Also add the user command directory to PATH
tomcat.doctor: Check the environment, QuickJS resources and configuration
tomcat.config.get: Read a configuration key, or print the complete configuration
tomcat.config.get.key: Configuration path, such as log.level or llm.default_model
tomcat.config.set: Update and validate a configuration key
tomcat.config.set.key: Configuration path, such as log.level or ui.language
tomcat.config.edit: Open the configuration in EDITOR (defaults to vi/notepad)
tomcat.session: List, create, switch, delete, archive or search sessions
tomcat.plugin.load.path: Plugin directory or plugin.json manifest path
tomcat.plugin.build.path: Plugin directory or plugin.json manifest path
tomcat.audit: List, inspect or export audit records
tomcat.skill.reload: Rescan Skill directories and show discovery results
tomcat.model: Manage models, API keys and the default model
tomcat.model.list: List available models and API key status
tomcat.model.add: Add or replace a user model
tomcat.model.add.api: Protocol family: openai, openai-responses, anthropic-messages or google-gemini
tomcat.model.add.provider: Provider name (determines the default API key environment variable)
tomcat.model.add.model_name: Upstream model name (defaults to the model ID)

tomcat.model.key.set: Store an API key for a provider or environment variable
tomcat.model.key.list: List API key slots required by current models
tomcat.install: Install a package, plugin or Skill
tomcat.install.scope_root: Explicit project root for scope installation
tomcat.install.force: Allow replacing resources with the same name in this scope
tomcat.uninstall: Uninstall a package and its resources from a scope
tomcat.uninstall.scope_root: Explicit project root for scope uninstallation
tomcat.packages.visibility: Filter by scope (defaults to current project, agent and global)
tomcat.packages.scope_root: Explicit project root for the scope view
tomcat.workspace: Add, list or remove workspace directories
tomcat.pathrules.add.path: Target path (supports ~; nonexistent paths are accepted with a warning)

tomcat.acp: Connect an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) client to the local shared service over stdio
tomcat.acp.long:
Connect an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) client to the local shared service over stdio. Usually launched by an ACP client; stdin/stdout carry protocol messages rather than an interactive terminal conversation. An actual connection reuses or starts the shared service as needed; viewing help does not connect.
These settings apply to sessions controlled by this connection. --mode selects the initial session mode; --plan-review, --question-policy and --plan-start control review after saving, ordinary question answers and the extra confirmation when explicitly starting a plan, respectively.
Automatic interaction policies do not bypass tool permissions. Saving or reviewing a plan does not authorize implementation; --plan-start=auto does not make saving or reviewing start development automatically.
tomcat.acp.skills_dir: Private Skills directory for sessions controlled by this connection; must be absolute and readable. Omit for no connection-specific directory; does not grant tool access
tomcat.acp.mode: Initial session mode: chat for normal interaction, plan for planning. Omit to preserve a loaded session's saved mode; new sessions use chat
tomcat.acp.plan_review: Independent review after saving a plan: ask first (default), auto to review automatically, or skip to omit review; does not start implementation
tomcat.acp.question_policy: Answer policy for ordinary ask_question calls: manual answers (default), or recommended options automatically; does not answer review, plan-start or tool-permission confirmations
tomcat.acp.plan_start: When explicitly starting a plan in Plan mode: ask for extra confirmation (default), or auto to omit that confirmation; saving or reviewing does not start work automatically, and tool permissions still apply
tomcat.serve: Manage the shared Agent Server; --stdio keeps standalone mode
tomcat.serve.start: Start or reuse the local shared service
tomcat.serve.status: Show service identity and running status as JSON
tomcat.serve.models: List the shared service's saved model catalog as JSON without starting or connecting to the service
tomcat.serve.stop: Stop the shared service and all tasks
tomcat.serve.restart: Stop all tasks and restart with the current version
tomcat.serve.run.agent_id: Agent identity of the shared service
tomcat.serve.print_schema: Export the Serve protocol schema and exit
tomcat.chat.resume: Resume the last session (the default behavior)
